about:
CKS Packaging, a Covenant Company, operates from its headquarters in Urbana, Illinois. The business was founded in 2007 and remains family-owned and operated, leveraging a reported 70 years of combined packaging experience within the family.

As an American manufacturer, CKS specializes in blow-molded plastic containers and supplies them across North America. Its production focuses on blow molding processes, with recent news highlighting PET packaging solutions for products such as peanuts, indicating capability in food-grade and specialty container design.

The company serves a broad set of end markets, explicitly listing beverage, food, household, automotive, agricultural chemical, and specialty industries. Concrete examples from its announcements include PET packaging for peanuts in the food sector and packaging built for automotive performance, demonstrating its reach across both consumer and industrial segments.

CKS points to its family-owned structure and the 70-year legacy of packaging knowledge as key differentiators, framing itself as a domestic manufacturer with deep-rooted expertise in plastic container production.
